text:
Filed **add-payee-form**: a single-screen payee-creation form — header, three text fields (name / sort code / account number), and the Confirmation-of-Payee "no match" result surfaced as an inline hint on the account field rather than a blocking dialog, with Continue/Cancel as ordinary buttons. This keeps the "no dialog" constraint literal (no `modal-dialog` node used) while still requiring the customer to see the CoP result before they can proceed, per seq 7 and seq 23.

One gap worth flagging: the vocabulary's `text-field.hint` isn't semantically a status/error slot, so the inline warning is riding on a generic hint string rather than a distinct error-tone element — there's no `tone` prop on `text-field` to mark it critical. If a sharper inline-error affordance is wanted later, that's a vocabulary addition, not something I can compose around today.
